title: ABS Document (DRAFT — non-normative, v0.1)
description: Draft JSON Schema for the ABS core document format. This is a starting point for the official JSON Schema chapter listed in ROADMAP.md and is NOT yet normative.

abs_version.description: Optional in v0.1, will be required starting v0.2.

evaluations.description: Session-level (chain) evaluations, operating over the whole trace. See EVALUATIONS.md.

actor.description: See VOCABULARY.md and CORE_MODEL.md#actor. Not restricted to a closed enum in v0.1.

action.description: See VOCABULARY.md. Not restricted to a closed enum in v0.1 — custom actions are permitted.

target.description: Meaning depends on the action category — see CORE_MODEL.md#target.

content.description: Free text, structured payload, or displayed content. Intentionally untyped in v0.1 — see ROADMAP.md, 'Content typing'.

capture.description: Names runtime values for later reuse via {{variable}} syntax. See VARIABLES.md.

with.description: Parameters for an outbound action, MAY reference captured variables.

blocking.description: Optional checkpoint flag. See EVALUATIONS.md, 'Failure semantics'.

evaluation.description: Per-type fields (value, pattern, schema, target, with, criteria, id, match, order, variable, min, max, after, max_steps, evaluations) are documented in EVALUATIONS.md and deliberately left open here (additionalProperties: true) pending the formal Evaluation Specification.
